title: {enemy:brute}
text:
一个{enemy:brute}挡在路上，皮糙肉厚。

你现在信{faith}，第 {faith_tier} 阶，经验值 {faith_points}。到了第一阶，血掉得越多，你打得越狠，留意回放里的数字。打完看看顶端栏的徽记涨了多少。

texts.en:
A {enemy:brute} blocks the road. Thick hide.

You follow {faith}: Rank {faith_tier}, {faith_points} XP. From Rank one, the more Health you lose, the harder you hit. Watch the numbers in the replay. Afterwards, check the emblem in the top bar to see how much you gained.

options.label: 进入战前准备
options.hint_when_hidden: 你现在信的不是{faith:brute}：右键{item:charm_brute}点「奉为主信仰」，切回来再打。

hints_when_hidden.en: You're not following {faith:brute} right now. Right-click the {item:charm_brute} and press Make main faith to switch back, then fight.
